header.title: How to Install a Garbage Disposal
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to safely install a new garbage disposal unit. It covers plumbing, electrical, and mechanical aspects of the installation process.

steps.description: The first step is to turn off the electricity by switching off the circuit breaker.
actions: Turn off the circuit breaker

steps.description: Disconnect the electrical and dishwasher connections from the appliances.
actions: Disconnect electrical connections
Disconnect dishwasher connections

steps.description: Disconnect the drainpipe and strainer from the p-trap and sink.
actions: Disconnect the down drainpipe coming from the sink
Disconnect the connection that attaches the down drainpipe to the p-trap
Remove the parts
Unscrew the large nut that holds the strainer in place
Remove the strainer body

steps.description: Remove old plumber's putty from around the drain opening.
actions: Clean off the old plumber’s putty

steps.description: Apply plumber's putty, insert the sink flange, and secure it in place.
actions: Place a ½” bead of new plumber’s putty around the drain opening in the sink.
Drop the new sink flange into the drain opening.
Press the sink flange into place.
Place a weight on top of the sink flange.
Place a towel between the sink surface and the weight.

steps.description: Slide the fiber gasket, backup flange, and mounting flange over the sink flange and hold them in place.
actions: Slide the fiber gasket over the sink flange
Slide the backup flange over the sink flange
Slide the mounting flange over the sink flange
Hold these pieces in place

steps.description: Attach the mounting ring and snap ring to the sink, then tighten the mounting screws.
actions: Slip on the mounting ring
Snap on the snap ring
Tighten the three mounting screws
Alternate tightening each screw a few turns at a time
Ensure the mounting assembly is evenly and tightly seated against the bottom of the sink

steps.description: If installing a dishwasher, tap out the dishwasher knockout plug from the disposer.
actions: Lay the disposer on its side
Use a screwdriver and hammer to tap out the dishwasher knockout plug
Remove the loose knockout plug from inside the disposer

steps.description: Connect the electrical wiring of the disposer to the power supply under the sink.
actions: Lay the disposer on its side under the sink
Make sure the circuit breaker is off
Remove the plate on the bottom of the disposer
Expose the wiring
Connect the wires from the disposer to the matching wires for the power supply using wire nuts
Secure the power cord to the bottom of the disposer
Replace the plate to cover the wires

steps.description: Hang the disposer by aligning mounting tabs with the mounting ring and locking them into place.
actions: Align the three mounting tabs with the slide-up ramps on the mounting ring.
Hold the disposer in place.
Turn the lower mounting ring until all three tabs are locked into the mounting assembly.

steps.description: Attach the discharge tube to the discharge coupler and secure it with a clamp on the rubber tailpipe coupler.
actions: Insert the discharge tube into the discharge coupler
Slide the clamp over the discharge tube
Position the clamp in the groove on the rubber tailpipe coupler
steps.part: Discharge tube, discharge coupler, clamp, rubber tailpipe coupler

steps.description: Connect the disposer's drain hose to the drain trap, adjusting the hose length if needed, and connecting to a dishwasher if applicable.
actions: Rotate the disposer so that the discharge tube is aligned with the drain trap.
Cut off excess length of the discharge tube if it is too long.
Purchase an extension if the discharge tube is too short.
Connect the disposer to a dishwasher through an air gap if necessary.
Attach the drain hose to the dishwasher inlet using a hose clamp.

steps.description: This step involves locking the disposer, installing a sink baffle, testing for leaks, and testing the disposer's operation.
actions: Lock the disposer to the sink mounting assembly using the special wrench.
Insert the Quiet Collar® Sink Baffle into the sink opening.
Press the Quiet Collar® Sink Baffle into the sink until it snaps into place.
Test for leaks at the sink flange.
Test for leaks at the dishwasher connection.
Test for leaks at the tail-pipe connection.
Test for leaks at the mounting assembly connections.
Turn on the electrical breaker to test its operation.
steps.part: disposer, sink mounting assembly, Quiet Collar® Sink Baffle, sink flange, dishwasher, tail-pipe, mounting assembly
